requirements.text: Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, with 1+ year of web development experience (internships count).
Frontend: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, and the ability to build pages and UI interactions independently.
Backend: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Python, or Java), and the ability to design and implement RESTful APIs independently.
Databases: Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design and basic query optimization.
Engineering Habits: Comfort with Git collaboration workflows, solid debugging skills, and a habit of writing unit tests.
Ownership & Communication: You learn fast, take ownership, communicate clearly, and proactively report progress and risks.
Bilingual: Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English.
Experience building admin systems, workflows, or automation tools.
Experience integrating third-party APIs, or familiarity with OAuth or webhooks.
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
